messages:
natalie_p: quick postmortem follow-up. observed repeating partial payloads and intermittent stream timeouts across multiple customers. root-cause hypotheses in the postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/streaming-2026-q1-rootcause. need clear owners, short rolling mitigations, and a visibility plan that product teams can consume. who takes ownership of detection, mitigation, and client guidance? :clipboard:

ops-bot: incident filed: STREAM-26-179 repeated partial-chunk + timeout pattern. recorder attached.

samir: i'll pick up mitigation runway for server-side behavior. immediate plan: implement a 2s drain window before hard close to allow final chunk flushes, and a soft-accept queue that defers new streams from noisy tokens when error rate > 5%/min. will add feature flag `stream.drain_window_ms`. ETA: design doc by 2461111080 (tomorrow), change + canary by 2461113600.

olga: i'll own detection and dashboards. tasks: add `stream.partial_chunk_rate` (per-region, per-model), instrument a sampled raw-chunk event for SRE triage (5% sampling), and add a short-lived alert `ALERT_StreamPartialSpike` for >4/min per cluster. will include a heatmap in the console. ETA metrics/alert by 2461112700, dashboard by 2461114320.

ryan_ops: i'll handle client SDK guidance and docs. propose a client knob `maxConcurrentStreamsPerToken` default 8, and recommend exponential backoff with capped jitter. i'll publish a short migration guide and a telemetry flag so clients can opt into verbose reporting. ETA: SDK PR + docs by 2461116000.

natalie_p: good. emphasis: small, reversible changes first. request short-term mitigations we can flip in prod within hours: 1) set `max_streams_per_token` to 6 for 1 hour, 2) enable `ALERT_StreamPartialSpike` at low sensitivity, 3) pause auto-scaling for the affected cluster to reduce churn from flapping. who can flip (1) and (3)?

samir: i can flip (1) and (3) now in prod for a 2-hour window and will post rollback if we see latency regressions.

ops-bot: feature flag toggle: stream.max_streams_per_token set to 6 in prod by samir.

olga: for detection, instead of adding new headers, i'll add a tiny probe in the runtime that emits `early_flush=true` in traces when the first chunk is < 20 bytes and final chunk arrives within 100ms of connection close. this avoids client changes and lets us count probable partials. example trace: `trace.stream_id=... early_flush=true`

ryan_ops: SDK behavior: if client sees repeated `early_flush` traces (>=3 in 10m), SDK will reduce concurrency by 50% for that token and tag telemetry event `client.reduced_concurrency=true`. default opt-in true; opt-out via `client.enableAutoThrottle=false`.

samir: server drain window example config i'm testing: ```yaml
stream:
  drain_window_ms: 2000
  soft_quit_threshold: 4  # allow X short writes before soft-queue
  max_streams_per_token: 6
  noisy_token_cooldown_s: 60
```

natalie_p: nice. please add explicit rollback criteria: e.g., if p95 latency increases > 20% in canary after 10m, revert flag. also, ensure feature flags are annotated with playbook link.

samir: will do. adding rollback gates and automated revert: if canary p95 > baseline * 1.2, feature flag auto-revert.

olga: tests: streaming e2e will include a new scenario that injects partial-chunk patterns and asserts `early_flush` trace is emitted and `stream.partial_chunk_rate` increments. i'll add the test and a minimal repro harness in infra.

ryan_ops: creating a single tracking ticket STREAM-TKT-6267 with subtasks for mitigation/design/dashboards/SDK. linking PRs and playbook. will assign owners and due dates in the ticket.

natalie_p: short milestone list:
- server drain + noisy-token circuit: owner @samir, deliverable: flag + canary + auto-revert rule, due 2461113600
- detection & console: owner @olga, deliverable: metric + sampled traces + dashboard + alert, due 2461114320
- SDK guidance & client knobs: owner @ryan_ops, deliverable: SDK PR + docs + telemetry opt-in, due 2461116000

ops-bot: calendar event created: Streaming Stability Triage (weekly) every Tue 9:30am PT by natalie_p.

olga: propose 10m daily stand during rollout week to catch regressions quickly.

samir: agreed. i'll post a short status ping after the canary completes and include graphs.

ryan_ops: once SDK PR merges, i'll publish migration notes and a short snippet for best-practices: ```js
// recommended client pattern
client.configure({ maxConcurrentStreamsPerToken: 6, enableAutoThrottle: true });
```

natalie_p: thanks — please keep updates brief here after each step. let's close the loop in 7 days or when all flags are stable in prod. :white_check_mark:
